purpose: Development observation, not strength or independent confirmation. Inspect current completed stability, score movement, retries, node growth and cost tails before choosing a clock policy.
baseline: Accepted build74 CP64 flags3407871 ADAPTIVE16 W1 Hash64; no policy change
method: Four 100000-node warmups per plain/observed owner; rotated plain/no-diagnostics and callback/diagnostics requests; newGame before each root; original real histories; two matched rounds; every resolved PV checked for legality, node accounting and drained helpers; exact result/node equivalence required. The historically named confirmation corpus is development data here.
analysis: Only completed iterations supply score/move samples. Mark selective estimates and mate scores separately. Describe one/two-step later changes by depth, three-iteration move stability, score deterioration and retries. Evaluate naive last-cost/parity forecasts as predictions with over/underprediction rates and tails, not guarantees. Completed deeper choices are diagnostic references, not ground truth. Wall costs include callback/diagnostic overhead; clean matched costs reported separately. Censored final iterations retain all cost and are not fabricated observations.
resources: Serial processes, one Search worker, BelowNormal, ActiveProcessorCount=2, Xmx768m, 60s per-request operational cap, 30min per-corpus cap. Retain failures; no retry or outcome exclusion. Host cost recorded; noisy wall data cannot support calibration. No games launched by this protocol.
nextDecision: Choose minimal supported bounded policies and controls, or reject unreliable signals with evidence; no coefficient sweep or production promotion. Freeze a new protocol before any further diagnostic or clock experiment.
